title: verify.rs: check_message_digest re-encodes Any to DER to decode as OctetString
description: check_message_digest() calls attr_value.to_der() then OctetString::from_der(&attr_der). This is a two-step encode-then-decode roundtrip. The der crate's Any type should support decode_as::<OctetString>() directly (as done elsewhere in the codebase, e.g. extract_cbc_iv uses params.decode_as::<OctetString>()). Replace the to_der() + from_der() sequence with attr_value.decode_as::<OctetString>() to eliminate the intermediate allocation.
